caption: The video depicts a woman filmed from behind, standing feet apart on a yoga mat in a plain white studio. A green foam roller and kettlebell rest against the wall to the left, while pink and yellow dumbbells lie on the floor to the right. She wears a teal sports top and light gray leggings, gripping a gray band with her right arm raised overhead and her left hand at her upper back. Her right arm slowly flexes at the elbow, lowering the gripping hand from overhead toward the back of her head and then behind her neck. As that hand descends, the visible band between the hands shortens as the distance between her hands decreases. Her left hand stays fixed at her shoulder blade while her torso, legs, and feet remain stationary, the body neither translating nor rotating. The camera and equipment hold their positions, framing the steady movement of the single arm.
